fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-html) carry a JSON-LD NewsArticle dict spread verbatim plus an HTML-scraped articleBody; latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry RSS item fields. Upstream JSON-LD/RSS is passed through close to verbatim, so extra fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (article URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-html for articles, S2-rss for latest headlines, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the JSON-LD NewsArticle block.

dateCreated.title: Date created
dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 creation date, from JSON-LD (WordPress theme also emits this alongside datePublished).

author.title: Author
author.description: Array of Person object(s) as emitted by JSON-LD (raw passthrough) -- name + URL to author page only, no email/jobTitle.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher organization object. Some /us-news/ and /business/ articles emit a regional sub-brand name (e.g. 'California Post') with a parentOrganization pointing back to 'New York Post' -- passed through verbatim, not normalized.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated or array of keywords, as emitted upstream in JSON-LD.

video.title: Video
video.description: Embedded video object, present on JSON-LD when the article has a video component.

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Upstream paywall metering flag -- not observed in initial recon (no sampled article was paywalled), but the theme's 'single--exclusive-article-disabled' CSS class implies a paywall feature exists and may surface this field on NYP+ content.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, joined from bare (unclassed)

tags of div.single__content.entry-content up to the first

. Not present in the JSON-LD block on this site -- merged in from HTML.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the RSS item (latest mode).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, from the RSS item.

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: Byline name, from the RSS item's WordPress dc:creator extension.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
